records.title: TopCoW images, masks and derived centerline graphs
records.version_note: TopCoW training release 15692630 and graph release 17358162, as curated on 2026-09-16 in BR-025; exact selected files, CRC checks and hashes remain in the curation receipt.
records.terms_note: Historical terms recorded in BR-025 on 2026-09-16: TopCoW requires attribution and owner permission for commercial use; derived graphs are CC BY-NC. These observations are not a current redistribution clearance.
records.reference_note: TopCoW masks cover named Circle of Willis components within the source annotation scope. Centerline graphs derive from those masks, so they are not a second independent anatomical truth. The retained 244-voxel BR-026 addition dispute is clinically unresolved.
records.access_note: Selected source images, masks and graph members were retained locally. This source index does not acquire data or establish current access; recheck exact terms and availability when selecting a release for reuse.

records.title: AeroPath airway CT and annotations
records.version_note: BR-033 historical source review, 2026-09-16: mirror revision 6d0f831ca22bf57918aba3980ae475c94d45b997; selected CT, airway and lung files were checked against published LFS SHA-256 digests.
records.terms_note: The retained license.md says CC BY 4.0, while the Hugging Face card says MIT. Preserve both declarations; neither the card nor the code repository alone resolves dataset redistribution terms. This is the 2026-09-16 observation, not a current license check.
records.reference_note: Manually refined airway/lung masks are separate from official Raidionics model predictions. Reference omissions can occur; binary masks do not establish named bronchi or biopsy-target truth. BR-033 parent-gap concerns are retained in its results.
records.access_note: Selected files and model outputs remain local, with exact hashes in the source receipt. No downloads, current-access verification or publication clearance were performed for this index.
